items.note: The eight-row schedule, the arbitrary-scratch invariance, y<-y+x per invocation and the three-stage composition to (-Y,X) with restoration all match lines 728-765. The essential computation that the net map (JV+RG)x is the identity (central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling the rest, lines 742-759), the neighbour rule and the wire counts are absent.

States D_out S D_in^{-1} and that endpoint frames alone fix each route; the method (stored array = frame of logical array, preserved by edges and by gates because a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate) is the paper's proof at 804-825. The signed route formula is paraphrased rather than written out.

Nondegenerate labels from triple indicators, orthogonal neighbouring lines, comparable labels, the single decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), the telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are all present. The derivation names the method but never gives the terminal labels, the stage transitions or the gate-label table eq:motif-labels (lines 881-988), nor the existence of orthonormal residual bases over F_2 (1073-1102); these are the substance of the construction.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at sources X_a, frame Phi_M, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N source edges as the only exceptions, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m follow the proof at 1156-1171. The reason the source edge has rank one (it is 2P_{U_a}) is not spelled out.

Phase frames, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, and C^{tensor mk} on every role after corrections are stated; the method names weight additivity mod 4. Missing are the step turning the character (-1)^{v.x} into the translation X_v (1249-1257) and the X_a->Y_a endpoint analysis (C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates fixed by C=iZC^{-1}Z, 1290-1310), which the plan only asserts as an outcome.

L<N/2 gives s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m; eta defined as relative deficit, both above 20*2^{-50}, log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, exactly the paper's chain. The exact eta values (339/22587335000000, 73/19906842167500) are not given, only described as tiny positive rationals.

The plan uses controlled shifts (O(V) lower-triangular updates) and cyclic row splitting into W streams, and cites stream-operations and controlled-shifts as dependencies, but never states the lemmas' content (the list of O(V) operations, the b^{O(1)} offset condition, rational unit scalings).

The factorization E_1 Pi E_2 and the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V) are stated, and the shear cost is derived by the paper's route (triangular factors as controlled shifts in descending order, three updates around one interchange per pivot). The elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1392) is only quoted, and the choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators (1413-1423) is absent.

Row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on edges by recursive interchanges, shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows, the three-update interchange, s calls, fixed-tape parking stack at O(V) per node, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau) all match 1491-1588.

High digits as a row field of range at least W^k, padding the row count to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces handled by the power-width procedure with a geometric sum, and padding binary ranges to [q^e] follow 1649-1734. Unequal widths (1740-1762) are not treated, which is incidental.

The plan states s_c child calls on the f=e/m axes of one slot and the layer identity H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, and says binary bases are changed by packed additions. The defining mechanism, conjugation by the address permutation P_M that moves the residual directions into coordinate slots (eq:phase-edge-coordinate), and the inverse-child formula (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, are missing, so it is not derived.

Eight whole-chunk shifts flipping the parity of u exactly when the control is one and restoring w, the bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, at most sixteen swaps and eight rotations, and deterministic repair by sorting are the paper's route; the cost is given in the specialised O(V(L^tau+1)) form the paper also states for the parameter family.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), the cut-off at e<d^beta and the summation to O(d^{lambda'}) all match. The source of the rows (the first q_0=O(log d) chunks taken as a row index, padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, lines 2306-2323), needed for the recursion to have rows to split, is absent.

O(Vd^{lambda'}) time, error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, exact Gaussian dyadic evaluation with dependency depth A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E bounded by C_0 d^{C_1}=o(p) via epsilon C_1<1, one final truncation and the row-sum-one disk argument follow the guard-width section and the proof.

Contraction, character cancellation by the shift argument, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed retained order B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the layout L, the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+ell d^{lambda'}]) and error sqrt2 ell 2^{-p} with its component costs all match.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, |h_j|<B_0/2, centered extraction, negacyclic wrap, four integer products with the established multiplier, O(rp log(rp)) are the paper's route.

Two forward transforms in retained order, pointwise products commuting with the record permutation, opposite transform, scaling by M, error sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p} and the stated cost all match 3391-3495.

The identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, Neumann-series inversion, contractions, error and cost, and the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 and the O(Tpd^2(1+ell^tau)) movement are right and follow the paper. S5.1 omits the hypothesis theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4 and the definitions (P_su)_j=u_{tj}, (P_tv)_k=v_{-sk} (the separation appears only in S6.1's method).

Both identities are stated and the cancellation RF^+R=F^+ with the two normalizations is derived as in 3955-3980. The chirp a=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is never defined and the Bluestein computation for QF_t (3938-3952) is only quoted.

b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i, the size relations, the prime intervals, T/2<S<T, alpha and the n^{o(1)} search are correct. eta=1/(4d) is never given, delta, lambda and tau are not listed, the prime-counting justification is only asserted, and gamma=o(b) (gamma<=b/4), needed later for exact recovery, is absent.
mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the isomorphism argument, the triangular coordinate formula, prefix-controlled shifts, padding preserved and O(Tpd^2(1+ell^tau)) cost match the paper.
x_d->zeta y well defined, diagonal, isometric, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ ., iota D_+ .)=(f*g)/T match 4303-4342; twist errors appear in S6.7.3.

Computed chirp transform, source transform with exact counterpart RF_s, opposite-sign transform by conjugation, and the six algorithm steps with the two scalings by S and 2^{2b+4}S follow the paper. The digit scaling by 2^{-b-2} is not mentioned explicitly.

The chain E_ring<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, product, opposite transform, E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2L, final error 448b2^{-b+gamma}<=448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries reproduces the paper's error accounting.

V=Tp=Theta(n), the seven table rows with their powers, margins g_1..g_7, min=2^{-181}=2 kappa, o(Tp) setup and repair, log factors absorbed by p^kappa, giving O(Tp p^{1-kappa})=O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}), match the paper. The schoolbook cutoff for small n is not mentioned.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n optimality conjecture in this model, but does not state what the negation requires (one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0).

errors.says: Over the label field, <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, so every triple line is nondegenerate and neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal (presented for both networks).
errors.paper: The formula |S cap T|-1 holds only for the bit network's rational form x^T(I-J/9)y on Q^h; the complex network uses F_2^h with the ordinary dot product, where t_S.t_T=|S cap T| mod 2 and t_T.t_T=1. The conclusion (nondegenerate lines, orthogonal neighbours) holds in both, but by different formulas.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: scalar exchange network, frames, labels and the budget Wm-2N+2L with L<N/2, then the two interfaces, the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}, interchange and simultaneous layers, synthetic transforms, resampling with retained permutations, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the construction level. The proof that one invocation adds x to y (the coefficient cancellation), the actual gate-label table, the P_M conjugation that turns residual directions into slots, the row source for the layer recursion and the chirp definition are asserted or skipped, not reconstructed.

steps.note: The fixed linear network on banks X,Y exchanging them as (X,Y)->(-Y,X) in three stages and restoring every scratch wire is stated, with h=100 and triples of [100] appearing in S1.1.3. The explicit values N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3, and the indexing of data pairs by triples of triples, are not given; the mechanism and role are present.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and only endpoint frames matter, leaving intermediate frames free to make edges cheap.

Nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional tensor cube from triple indicators, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being central wires from time 3 to 4 each losing h=100 are all stated (the explicit gate labels are not).
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, with the N source edges as the exceptions costing one extra rank each.
Signed sum Wm-2N plus 2L with L=Ich gives Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b is stated in S1.2.
L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on every input role, so the same shear H<-H+D appears on every role.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular factors in O(V), one interchange per pivot by three updates, so exactly a recursive interchanges per edge and s per node.
Children on streams of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) by a geometric sum.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole chain of the central saving: exchange network, frames, labels with the single decreasing edge, rank equal to dimension change with N source exceptions, the budget, L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The thin spots are the explicit N and m and the concrete gate labels, which are named but not written out.
